description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and extension methods related to configuring named services within the Orleans framework, particularly for dependency injection and options configuration.

classes.name: NamedServiceConfigurator
classes.description: A class implementing INamedServiceConfigurator that associates configurations and subcomponents with a named service.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Extension method to configure options for a named service.

methods.name: ConfigureComponent
methods.description: Extension method to add a singleton component and configure its options for a named service.

methods.name: ConfigureComponent
methods.description: Overload extension method to add a singleton component for a named service using a factory.

methods.name: ConfigureLifecycle
methods.description: Extension method placeholder for configuring lifecycle-related behavior for a service.
